answer: Mechanism: VDF-paced coordination-slot auction. A falcon beacon advances epochs; each epoch exposes a grove of fixed slots. Multi-agent actions must reserve a slot and post a comet commitment to causal predecessors. Slots are sealed-bid auctioned and consumed serially per dependency chain. A sybil swarm needs one slot per concurrent identity, paying N clearing prices plus serialized VDF delay to forge independent histories. Attacker cost: N×slot fee + O(N) epoch latency, scaling with coordination breadth.
